scope: DFlash2 verify trees (--verify-tree) and their prompt-lookup chains for fafstmobel on one RTX 5090 (32 GB), measured against DFlash2 path verification. Trees change which drafts are verified, not the output distribution: greedy rows follow the target argmax and sampling rows sample the target distribution at every visited node. Outputs are not token-identical to path verification because K8V4 rows quantized in differently shaped verify blocks differ in their last bits, the same kind of divergence path verification shows against plain decoding. Accepted tokens per round is the controlled metric; decode tokens/s also includes round cost and run-to-run variance.
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB; desktop GPU workloads active during measurement; the board runs at its 575 W power limit
model: fafstmobel NInfer v3 artifact; DFlash2 with 15 draft tokens; optimized proposal head (--lm-head-draft); K8V4 KV cache; 1024-token prefill chunks; CUDA Graphs

serving_chat.method: ninfer-serve, max concurrency 1, no prefix reuse; 16 coding tasks (system prompt plus one user request), OpenAI Chat streaming, thinking with reasoning effort medium, 1024 output tokens per request; server restarted between variants. Sampling rows use the model defaults (temperature 1, top-k 20, top-p 0.95). The tree runs in this table predate prompt lookup.
serving_chat.prompt_lookup_on_chat: Same tasks, seeds 1 and 2, trees without vs with the lookup chain: 4.086 vs 4.008 accepted per round; the per-request paired difference is -0.9% with a standard error of 1.8% (no measurable effect).

agent_edit_tasks.method: ninfer CLI, one request each: a source file (1-2K tokens) in the prompt with an instruction to change it and print the complete updated file; reasoning effort low, model default sampling, seed 7, up to 3000 output tokens. Trees without vs with the prompt-lookup chain.

rows.task: Python script: add two CLI options and a progress print
Python script: extract a class and add type hints
C++ header: add documentation comments and one helper

product_benchmark.method: ninfer_bench on the bench corpus, greedy, 512 generated tokens, three alternating runs per variant; trees before prompt lookup.

quality.perplexity: ninfer-perplexity, 1M corpus quick, K8V4, context 65536, stride 32768: 4.08607 before and after (prefill path).
quality.greedy_rescoring: 8 raw-text prompts x 512 greedy tokens rescored by the causal scorer: mean log-probability of emitted tokens -0.1500 (path) vs -0.1447 (tree); tokens below -1: 132 vs 123.

product_benchmark_with_lookup.method: ninfer_bench on the bench corpus, greedy, 512 generated tokens, three alternating runs per variant; path verification at de95662 vs verify trees with prompt lookup at a82d183.
